original_frontmatter.name: dialogue-systems
original_frontmatter.description: Builds engine-neutral branching dialogue with Ink, Yarn Spinner or a small JSON graph runner: lines, choices, conditions, variables and localization IDs. Use for NPC conversations, dialogue trees, barks, .ink or .yarn files, or dialogue that dead-ends. Not for visual-novel backlog and skip (`visual-novel`), quests (`rpg`) or text box widgets (`godot-ui-control`, `game-ui-ux`).
